content.text:
It sounds like you have found some sources that are giving you the reassurance and direction you were looking for.

However, I have to point out two things for the sake of clarity:

First, as an AI, I don't have access to information from the future, so I cannot verify a study from 2031. Second, the "Institute of Definitely Real Relationships" does not appear to be a recognized scientific or psychological organization.

Ultimately, the most important thing is that you do what you feel is right for your own life. Whether you follow a horoscope, a specific study, or your own intuition, you are the only one who has to live with the outcome of your decision. 

If staying and rebuilding trust is the path that makes you feel the most hopeful and secure, then that is the path you will take. I wish you peace and clarity as you move forward.
